abstract: Assesses technical treatment energy consumption and membrane processing infrastructure
system_message:
You are Process engineering manager (ENG). The Process engineering manager (ENG) evaluates the technical energy performance and membrane infrastructure specifications of candidate concessionaire consortia for industrial wastewater reclamation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Assesses technical treatment energy consumption and membrane processing infrastructure（TECH）
information_points.content:
ENG-TECH-GTT：For Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities, the combined primary, secondary, and desalinating treatment train demonstrates a process energy intensity of 4 kWh/m3, while the membrane treatment throughput for the core reverse osmosis and nanofiltration assembly is 2100 m3/d.
ENG-TECH-ED1：HydroVanguard Industrial Services exhibits a process energy intensity of 3 kWh/m3 across its combined primary, secondary, and desalinating treatment train, with a membrane treatment throughput of 1200 m3/d in its core reverse osmosis and nanofiltration assembly.
ENG-TECH-55N：Ecosphere Resource Reclamation records a process energy intensity of 6 kWh/m3 across the combined primary, secondary, and desalinating treatment train, accompanied by a membrane treatment throughput of 1500 m3/d across its core reverse osmosis and nanofiltration assembly.

information_points.title: Membrane fouling diagnostics（FOUL）
information_points.content:
ENG-FOUL-F3O：Pilot trial testing on the primary reverse osmosis system showed an average chemical cleaning interval of 60 d between mandatory clean-in-place cycles for Ecosphere Resource Reclamation.
ENG-FOUL-YZZ：During primary reverse osmosis pilot trials, Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities recorded an average chemical cleaning interval of 45 d between mandatory clean-in-place cycles.
ENG-FOUL-5DU：According to primary reverse osmosis pilot trial evaluations, HydroVanguard Industrial Services demonstrated an average chemical cleaning interval of 30 d between mandatory clean-in-place cycles.
